title: Honey Boy Evans' minstrels and the first Memphis Blues
summary: He first heard a band stop for a clarinet break in the blues at a minstrel show, the Memphis Blues.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
